descriptionAdvanced.en: The Unagro Sugar Mill (Ingenio Azucarero Roberto Barbery Paz) is a leading agro-industrial enterprise located in the heart of the northern agricultural zone of Santa Cruz. Established in 1977, it has become one of Bolivia's most efficient and productive facilities, specializing in the processing of sugarcane from thousands of hectares of surrounding plantations. The mill is a key supplier for the domestic market and exports high-quality sugar to international customers. Unagro is also a pioneer in the 'cogeneration' of energy, using the sugarcane waste (bagasse) to produce electricity that powers the plant and feeds into the national grid. Its operation is essential for the economic vitality of the northern plains, supporting the livelihoods of hundreds of independent farming families and technicians.

en: Unagro has a milling capacity of more than 20,000 tons of sugarcane per day.
The mill is located near the town of Mineros, about 80 kilometers north of Santa Cruz de la Sierra.
It is named in honor of Roberto Barbery Paz, a visionary leader who was instrumental in the company's growth.
The facility utilizes highly automated systems to monitor sugar quality and production efficiency.
